summary.en: Gunmen continue to attack civilians in Plateau, killing a 60-year-old woman harvesting groundnuts and injuring two farmers, and separate Fulani attackers killed a farmer and wounded another. In the north-east, unknown gunmen killed at least ten villagers in a raid after Friday prayers, with later reports raising the death toll to forty. Bandits abducted two farmers in a Kaduna community. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Våpenbærende menn fortsetter å angripe sivile i Plateau, og drepte en 60‑år gammel kvinne som høstet jordnøtter og såret to bønder, mens separate Fulani-angripere drepte en bonde og såret en annen. I nord-øst drepte ukjente væpnede menn minst ti landsbyboere i et raid etter fredagsbønn, og senere rapporter økte dødstallet til førti. Banditter bortførte to bønder i et samfunn i Kaduna. Konflikten førte til 1 486 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Boko Haram insurgency
background.extract: The Boko Haram insurgency began in July 2009, when the militant Islamist and jihadist rebel group Boko Haram started an armed rebellion against the government of Nigeria. Boko Haram targets both Muslims and Christians. Attacks are often directed at individuals perceived as supporting the Nigerian government or Islamic State after the split between them, including civil servants, local defense groups, Muslim leaders who oppose the group and other rebels like al-Qaeda and Islamic State. Most attacks are not based on the religion of the victims.
